facts.text: Mayflower Inn & Spa is at 118 Woodbury Road in Washington, Connecticut, in the Litchfield Hills.
facts.excerpt: is located at 118 Woodbury Road in Washington, Connecticut, in the Litchfield Hills, roughly two hours from New York City.

facts.text: The property sits in 58 acres of landscaped gardens and woodland.
facts.excerpt: nestled in 58 acres of beautifully landscaped gardens and woodland

facts.text: Accommodation is in an English country house style main building plus three standalone cottages.
facts.excerpt: set against the backdrop of a lavish English country house and three standalone cottages

facts.text: The Retreat is the hotel's 20,000-square-foot holistic wellness destination.
facts.excerpt: The Retreat, Mayflower Inn & Spa's 20,000-square-foot holistic wellness destination

facts.text: The Retreat offers facials by Biologique Recherche.
Guests have an outdoor pool and an indoor spa pool.
facts.excerpt: Mayflower Inn & Spa has an outdoor pool and an indoor spa pool for hotel guests.

facts.text: The hotel is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes from Bradley International Airport near Hartford.
facts.excerpt: approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes from Bradley International Airport (BDL) near Hartford, CT

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly; guests should contact it directly for current pet policies.
facts.excerpt: Mayflower Inn & Spa is pet-friendly; guests should contact the hotel directly for current pet policies

facts.text: The hotel unveiled a total renovation in late 2020 to mark its 100th anniversary.
facts.excerpt: unveiled a total renovation in celebration of its 100th anniversary

facts.text: Interior designer Celerie Kemble designed the current interiors.
facts.excerpt: interior designer Celerie Kemble did at Mayflower Inn & Spa

facts.text: The Garden Room is known for its mirrored latticework.
facts.excerpt: the Garden Room, distinguished by its beautiful mirrored latticework

facts.text: The Tap Room serves pub fare.
facts.excerpt: Mayflower Inn & Spa’s Tap Room, which serves delicious pub fare

facts.text: The hotel has a garden that supplies ingredients to its dining.
facts.excerpt: Our picturesque garden is designed to bring fresh ingredients directly to your plate

facts.text: Guest activities include hiking through meadows and wetlands, and an evening bonfire with s'mores.
facts.excerpt: Hike through meadows and wetlands, enjoy a day of treatments at our holistic wellbeing destination or sit out by the bonfire with snacks and s'mores

facts.text: Tennis with a pro is among the activities the hotel lists.

facts.excerpt: Online booking is temporarily unavailable. Our reservations teams are ready to take your booking by phone.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards every year from 2017 to 2026.
